production.note: US model years. First: 'Subaru Announces Pricing on All-New 2022 BRZ' (22 July 2021), which 'arrives at Subaru retailers this fall'. Still on sale: Subaru of America's 24 September 2025 release announces pricing for the 2026 BRZ, which 'will arrive in retailers early next year' (subaru-us-2026-brz-pricing).

configuration.note: 'Engine: DOHC 4-cyl. 2.4-liter BOXER, direct and port fuel injection'

displacementL.note: Subaru's sheet gives litres only ('2.4-liter BOXER'); no cc figure was found on an opened Subaru page. The shared FA24 engine is 2,387 cc per Toyota's GR 86 release ('bumping up from 1,998cc to 2,387cc') (toyota-us-2022-gr86-thrills), which also rounds to 2.4.

aspiration.note: 'New, more powerful 2.4-liter (naturally aspirated) 228 hp SUBARU BOXER® engine'

fuel.note: Inferred from 'direct and port fuel injection' on a conventional piston engine.

transmission.note: 'six-speed close-ratio manual transmission or a six-speed electronic direct-control automatic transmission'

powerHp.note: 2022 model year. Quote: "Horsepower: 228 @ 7,000 rpm". The pricing release says "2.4-liter (naturally aspirated) 228 hp SUBARU BOXER® engine" (subaru-us-2022-brz-pricing), and the 2026 pricing release still gives "228 horsepower sent to the rear wheels" (subaru-us-2026-brz-pricing).

weightLb.note: 2022 model year. Quote from the 'Basic Specifications' block: "Curb weight: 2,815 lb.", listed with "Transmission: 6-speed manual standard; 6-speed automatic available". The sheet gives one figure and does not name the trim or transmission; it is taken to be the standard car (Premium, 6-speed manual). Subaru's own copy of this At-A-Glance (media.subaru.com/view-spec.do?bFileId=35000) is linked from the pricing release; the copy read is the identical file '22MY_BRZ_-_AAG_-FINAL.pdf' rehosted by Repairer Driven News.
